verdict.rationale: Mailgun has a public pricing page (mailgun.com/pricing). It lists plan features such as dedicated IP pools and SAML SSO and a free allowance of 100 emails/day. Community posts mention free-tier limits and a roughly $20/mo spend, so some self-serve pricing is visible without a sales call. Missing for 10: published per-volume tier prices, overage rates, explicit add-on costs for dedicated IPs and email validation, and confirmation that all tiers can be priced without contacting sales.
